heading, Clinicians didn’t enter healthcare to spend their days documenting. Yet administrative work now takes up around 40 percent of clinical time, pushing work into evenings, driving burnout, and pulling focus away from patients.Tandem is a complete AI medical assistant built in response to that reality. It supports clinicians before, during, and after the patient visit, helping reduce the time and effort spent on documentation so attention stays with the patient. Built and run by clinicians, Tandem fits into existing systems and reflects everyday clinical work. Less time on admin. More time for care., level 3

heading, Lukas Saari
CEO & Co-founder, level 6

Lukas has a habit of seeing the obvious long before others do. He led McKinsey’s Nordic AI and digitization practice by pushing health systems toward data-driven care years before it became the standard. Before that he worked on machine learning at Spotify. At Tandem he is placing the right bets again, whether it is hiring clinicians to shape the product or building the organization to scale fast.

heading, Oscar Boldt-Christmas
CCO & Co-founder, level 6

Oscar has spent two decades deep inside European healthcare as a Senior Partner at McKinsey. He has seen what works, what breaks, and what actually changes outcomes for patients. He joined Tandem because progress in healthcare happens too slowly, and someone needed to build technology that could finally speed it up.

heading, Oliver Åstrand
CTO & Co-founder, level 6

Oliver has built advanced AI at Google X, Uber, and fast-moving startups like Depict and Mavenoid. He knows how to turn research into products people rely on every day. At Tandem he is applying that approach to healthcare, a field where better engineering translates directly into better lives.

heading, Björn Zoega
Medical Advisor, level 6
Former hospital director of Karolinska University Hospital and currently vice director of King Faisal Specialist Hospital.

heading, Pär-Jörgen Pärson
Board Member, level 6
Partner at Northzone who has led investments in Spotify, iZettle, Avito, Pricerunner and Spring Health.

heading, Cristina Stenbeck
